parties.raw_findings:
### TARGET SUMMARY
McCarthy Building Companies, Inc. is a national general contractor with a Los Angeles office at 515 S. Flower St., Suite 3600, Los Angeles, CA 90071 (phone: 213-655-1100, email: la@mccarthy.com), holding California Contractors License 411173 (classes A, B, C-8), focused on LA-area healthcare, education, parking, and public projects like the $72M Cesar Chavez Workforce Building at LA City College and Colburn Center expansion; priority entry for interior design via Business Development Director Chris DeHaven and LA leadership on interior-heavy builds. https://www.mccarthy.com/locations/los-angeles https://www.mccarthy.com/insights/mccarthy-breaks-ground-on-72m-sustainable-administration-workforce-building-at-los-angeles https://labusinessjournal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/20251110_labj_018-20_Const-LIST.pdf

### PEOPLE
#### Decision Maker Drill-Down
- **Chris DeHaven**  
  Specific role/title: Director, Business Development, Los Angeles office.  
  Contact info found: cdehaven@mccarthy.com; 515 S. Flower St., Suite 3600, Los Angeles, CA 90071; 213-655-1100 (office).  
  Why this person matters for winning interior design work: Leads LA business development for projects with interior fit-outs like Providence Tarzana expansions (lobbies, patient towers) and award-winning healthcare/education builds, influencing subcontractor selection.  
  Best access route: Direct email or LA office phone for project-specific interior pitches; McCarthy trade partners plan room.  
  Potential meeting opportunities: ENR California Best Projects events (2024 winner: Tarzana Reimagined); DBIA Western Pacific Region awards (2023 Project of the Year: CSULA Student Housing); LA AGC/DBIA mixers.  
  Source URLs: https://www.mccarthy.com/locations/los-angeles

- **Michael Kim**  
  Specific role/title: Senior Vice President, McCarthy Building Companies (LA office leadership on LACCD projects).  
  Contact info found: LA office 213-655-1100; la@mccarthy.com.  
  Why this person matters for winning interior design work: Oversees LACCD portfolio including $72M Cesar Chavez Building (67,230 SF with lobbies, educational spaces, LEED interiors; 10th McCarthy-LACCD project), approving design-build interiors.  
  Best access route: LACCD project channels or McCarthy LA office outreach.  
  Potential meeting opportunities: LACCD Measure CC groundbreakings/open houses; higher ed construction conferences (e.g., tied to SBVC projects).  
  Source URLs: https://www.mccarthy.com/insights/mccarthy-breaks-ground-on-72m-sustainable-administration-workforce-building-at-los-angeles

- **Sarah Carr**  
  Specific role/title: Vice President, McCarthy Building Companies (higher ed focus).  
  Contact info found: Via corporate channels; LA office 213-655-1100.  
  Why this person matters for winning interior design work: Drives higher ed projects like $94M San Bernardino Valley College Student Services Building (104,000 SF with counseling, tutoring, wellness interiors pursuing LEED Platinum), influencing sustainable interior selections.  
  Best access route: Higher ed bid portals or McCarthy trade partners.  
  Potential meeting opportunities: Community college district events; ENR higher ed forums.  
  Source URLs: https://www.constructiondive.com/news/mccarthy-california-college-project-higher-ed/803203/

- **Amanda Corbet**  
  Specific role/title: Vice President, Business Development (higher ed strategic lead).  
  Contact info found: Via corporate; LA office 213-655-1100.  
  Why this person matters for winning interior design work: Prioritizes higher ed market with focus on mission-driven interiors (e.g., SBVC collaboration spaces), guiding partnerships for sustainable projects.  
  Best access route: Business development outreach on education bids.  
  Potential meeting opportunities: Higher ed construction conferences; DBIA events.  
  Source URLs: https://www.constructiondive.com/news/mccarthy-california-college-project-higher-ed/803203/

#### Gatekeeper Drill-Down
No specific gatekeepers (e.g., executive assistants, estimating admins, procurement coordinators) named in public sources; LA office general line (213-655-1100) or la@mccarthy.com serve as initial access points. https://www.mccarthy.com/locations/los-angeles

### COMPANY
Legal name: McCarthy Building Companies, Inc.; DBA: McCarthy Building Cos, Inc.; type: General Contractor (GC); specialties/markets: Healthcare, education, parking structures, hospitality, life sciences, infrastructure; employee count: Not specified (national with LA office); revenue range: Not specified; delivery methods: Design-build, preconstruction (e.g., Providence Tarzana); licensing: California Contractors License 411173 (A, B, C-8, active); ownership structure: Privately held; LA office: 515 S. Flower St., Suite 3600, Los Angeles, CA 90071. Matches provided license 411173-B. https://www.mccarthy.com/locations/los-angeles https://www.cslb.ca.gov/onlineservices/checklicenseII/checklicense.aspx (license lookup confirms active status, classes A/B/C-8, bonding/workers comp compliant).

### NETWORKING OPPORTUNITIES
- Association memberships/awards: ENR California (2024 Best Project Healthcare: Tarzana Reimagined; 2023 Top Contractor); DBIA Western Pacific Region (2023 Project of the Year: CSULA Student Housing).  
- Upcoming events: Not listed directly; leverage ENR Best Projects ceremonies, DBIA awards, LACCD project groundbreakings (e.g., Cesar Chavez).  
- Charity/community: Partnering with Adaptive Construction Solutions for veterans on renewables; local hiring/investing via UC Davis Health Anchor Institute Mission (50% local workforce goals).  
- Trade groups: McCarthy online plan room for bids; AGC/DBIA inferred via awards.  
Sources: https://www.mccarthy.com/locations/los-angeles https://www.mccarthy.com/trade-partners https://project.mccarthy.com/catower/

### DISCOVERED PROJECTS
- Cesar Chavez Administration & Workforce Building: Groundbreaking complete, $72M, 67,230 SF, LA City College (East Hollywood), completion early 2027, LEED interiors; why it matters: Educational/lobby design opportunities, 10th LACCD project. https://www.mccarthy.com/insights/mccarthy-breaks-ground-on-72m-sustainable-administration-workforce-building-at-los-angeles
- Colburn Center: $223M, 100,000 SF expansion (1,000-seat hall), DTLA, 2024-2027; why it matters: High-end performing arts interiors. https://labusinessjournal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/20251110_labj_018-20_Const-LIST.pdf
- Kedren Children's Village: $144M, 42,392 SF (maintenance/admin/warehouse), 710 E. 111th Place LA 90059, 2024-2027, LEED Gold; why it matters: Utility/interior upgrades. https://labusinessjournal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/20251110_labj_018-20_Const-LIST.pdf
- Providence Tarzana Reimagined: Complete, 200,000 SF patient tower + expansions/parking, Tarzana CA; why it matters: Award-winning healthcare interiors. https://www.mccarthy.com/projects/providence-tarzana-reimagined
- San Bernardino Valley College Student Services: Groundbreaking Oct 2024, $94M, 104,000 SF, completion Spring 2027, LEED Platinum; why it matters: Student wellness/counseling interiors. https://www.constructiondive.com/news/mccarthy-california-college-project-higher-ed/803203/
- California Tower (UC Davis Health): Make-ready phase, bid packages 2024-25, construction early 2025, 14-story hospital; why it matters: Local hiring/subcontractor interiors. https://project.mccarthy.com/catower/

### DISCOVERED ENTITIES
- Owners/clients: LACCD (recurring, 10+ projects); Colburn School; LA Dept of Water and Power; Providence Health System; San Bernardino Community College District; UC Davis Health.  
- Architects/design partners: Gehry Partners (Colburn); Vertrees A&E (Kedren); Steinberg Hart/HED (LACCD); Perkins&Will, Taylor Design (Tarzana); CannonDesign, AECOM (SBVC).  
- Engineers: IMEG, KPFF, Syska Hennessy (Tarzana); SafeWork (SBVC).  
- Related: Adaptive Construction Solutions (veterans/renewables partner); Pankow Builders (competitor on LA projects).  
Sources: https://labusinessjournal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/20251110_labj_018-20_Const-LIST.pdf https://www.mccarthy.com/projects/providence-tarzana-reimagined https://www.constructiondive.com/news/mccarthy-california-college-project-higher-ed/803203/

### ENTRY POINTS
- Email/call Chris DeHaven (cdehaven@mccarthy.com, 213-655-1100) pitching interiors for Colburn/Cesar Chavez. https://www.mccarthy.com/locations/los-angeles
- Register on McCarthy trade partners plan room for LA project bids (interior subs). https://www.mccarthy.com/trade-partners
- Attend ENR/DBIA award events (Tarzana/CSULA wins) for LA team face-time. https://www.mccarthy.com/locations/los-angeles
- Outreach LACCD/owners on active projects (e.g., Cesar Chavez interiors via Michael Kim). https://www.mccarthy.com/insights/mccarthy-breaks-ground-on-72m-sustainable-administration-workforce-building-at-los-angeles
- Monitor project sites like California Tower for sub bids (local purchase goals). https://project.mccarthy.com/catower/

### RED FLAGS
None identified; strong awards, no lawsuits/safety/financial issues in sources.
